_comment: Narrow data-limited exceptions for the UK replay qualification gate, reviewed like code under cos d1344. An entry requires coherent zero candidate effects, never-usable input lineage from budget_inputs, and a passing positive-input probe from the same attempt. It always requires a named reviewer's acceptance. The 17 October 2026 decision is adopted by the Budget coordinator following independent review agreement under cos d1344: RULE AGREE (GPT-6.1 Sol, round 2, 17 October 2026, head 7f518ff61) and CODE AGREE WITH NITS (round 3, head dbc1806df), with the P3 nit fixed in this commit.
